Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1152129. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Return the exact columns specified. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
